key.text: I want to make a phone stand for my desk out of wood. It should hold my phone at a slight angle, fit in my hand, and I only need one.

output.summary: You are making a wooden phone stand for your desk.

needs.why: To cut and shape the wood for the stand.

routes.process: Cut pieces from a plywood sheet and glue them together at an angle.
routes.fit_reason: This uses basic woodworking tools available at the maker space. It is a simple build for a beginner.

steps.title: Cut the wood
steps.detail: Use power tools to cut small pieces of plywood for the base and back.

steps.title: Sand the edges
steps.detail: Use sanders (machines that smooth surfaces) to make the edges smooth.

steps.title: Assemble the stand
steps.detail: Glue the pieces together so your phone rests at a slight angle.

warnings.issue: Power tools can be dangerous if you rush.
warnings.fix: Ask staff for help before using any saw or sander.
